R2's six 'golden identities' are largely algebraic consequences of the mixing number's own definition once the two literal torsion values -3 and -5 are fixed by hand; presenting them as a 'cross-check' between two independently-computed arcs (B753 quantum-topology, B425 classical-topology) risks reading definitional self-consistency as an empirical convergence — a type match (both quantities live in the same golden/Eisenstein number-theoretic ecosystem) is being read as physical significance ('the two-column law... appearing inside the mixing matrix itself').

classify(*c_sig) and classify(*theta_sig) are called on literal ground-truth tuples that were never derived from the S1/S2/S3 booleans computed above them in the same file; the 'swap fails' test (line 97: swap_c_in_theta_slot = classify(*c_sig)) is testing the SAME literal against the SAME classify() function that trivially maps it by definition — no computed fact could ever make the gate fail, which is exactly the vacuity the arc's own retraction names.

The original (pre-retraction) FINDINGS.md and results.json headline claimed the gate 'halves the Phase-3 correspondence enumeration 8->4', a phenomenological/interpretive claim about which correspondence 'survives'; the actually-computed content (S1-S3 discriminating facts) supports only that c and theta are distinguishable objects, not that any enumeration is thereby halved — this gap is exactly what B784 retracted.

The arc firewalls its own interpretive content correctly in text ('the observer/Born interpretation is priced to C18, firewalled... No consciousness claim'), but the underlying move — reading an abstract regular-action-has-no-fixed-point fact (true for ANY nontrivial group acting on itself, not special to this object) as 'the object structurally cannot choose, so an observer is needed' — is exactly a dimension/structure-type coincidence being offered as physical necessity; the group-theoretic content computed here (freeness of a regular action) is a tautology once the (Z/2)^3-torsor premise (imported from B766/C20) is granted.

B1 declares P16.1 (tracking=theta) 'CONFIRMED... Confidence: HIGH' based on a word-level algebraic identity (sigma_mirror = R.sigma.R), but the arc's own adversarial pass (C2 Attack B) shows no trace-map intertwining was demonstrated between this word-level theta and the character-variety theta of A2 -- 'they share a name but not a demonstrated mathematical connection.' The HIGH-confidence label in B1 is not walked back to reflect this gap even though C2 (same arc) identifies it as the second-strongest attack.

The entire proposal-#16 framework identifies pointer 'binary choices' (direction, tracking, level) with the F_2^3 torsor generators (theta, gamma_5, c) chiefly because both sides are Z/2-valued; the arc's own Attack D ('Bit-type coincidence is not structure') calls two of the three assignments 'numerological or worse' precisely on these grounds.
